name: 🥪 Sandwich Tycoon!
desc:
🥪Welcome to Sandwich Tycoon!🥪
⭐Join for +15% Cash Boost! - https://www.roblox.com/groups/4924354

🤑2x Cash and Rebirths on weekends!
🔥Premium Players get a 25% Cash Boost!
👍Like/Favorite the game and join the group for a 15% Cash Boost!

Hire "Chefs" to make sandwiches 👨‍🍳
Discover new and better sandwiches to grow your tycoon🥪
Fight others trying to take your spot as the sandwich god⚔️
Rebirth your tycoon as many times as you want for a permanent cash boost!💸
Compete with friends and climb the leaderboards! 👥

Have fun, this game is honestly super chill! 😎

⚠️Game is in early development, if you encounter a bug, report it in my group wall.
✔️Rebirth multiple times with a single button!
✔️Tycoon Data SAVES!
